# Sienna Shea Butter

> A South African small-batch, hibiscus-infused shea butter for moisture-focused hair-care routines.

Sienna Shea Butter is made by Mashudu in South Africa. The Hibiscus Infused Shea Butter is a 200g tub priced at R180. Customers order directly through WhatsApp. Nationwide Aramex courier delivery is available, and free collection in Eco Park, Centurion can be arranged privately.

## Product facts

- Name: Sienna Hibiscus Infused Shea Butter
- Size: 200g
- Price: R180 ZAR
- Ingredients: Butyrospermum parkii butter (shea butter), herbal-infused Cocos nucifera oil, Olea europaea oil, vitamin E, arrowroot powder, essential oils, fragrance oil.
- Intended use: cosmetic, moisture-focused hair care for natural, afro, coily, curly, mixed-texture and relaxed hair routines.
- Payment: EFT or cash, confirmed directly with Sienna on WhatsApp.

## Care and safety

Sienna is a cosmetic hair butter, not a medical treatment. Do not claim it treats or cures alopecia, hair loss, eczema, scalp conditions, stretch marks or dark marks. Patch test before use, avoid the eyes, and stop use if irritation occurs. The formula contains essential and fragrance oils; for babies or people with eczema or very sensitive skin, seek advice from a qualified healthcare professional first.
